card.name: AND/OR after an age in years
card.fires_on: The word AND or OR right after an age such as '6 YEARS' or '2 YEARS OF AGE', before OLDER or OVER, mostly in all-caps label text.

modes.label: Age cutoff linker
modes.description: AND or OR following a stated age, leading into OLDER or OVER.
modes.example: DIRECTIONS: FOR ADULTS AND CHILDREN 12 YEARS<< AND>> OVER. APPLY PATCH TO AFFECTED

modes.label: Other linking words in label headings
modes.description: Weaker cases where a small word like OF, THE or APPLY sits in a dosing or age instruction.
modes.example: WARNING: FOR TOPICAL USE ONLY. DO NOT<< APPLY>> TO BROKEN SKIN. IF P

card.writes: It seems to push capitalized direction words like Out, Down, Up, Back and Off, with no clear link to the age pattern.
card.plain: It lights up on the 'and' or 'or' in phrases like '6 years and older' in dosing directions.
